text: Internal Communications Plan:
After New York is notified of the verdict, Han or his designee will begin revising the
final draft of a news release – or language to be inserted in the verdict news release –
addressing corporate and/or financial issues raised by the verdict. Final approval of the
release (or inclusion in the verdict release) will be made by the appropriate PM
executives.
Han or his designee also will begin revising the final draft of a corporate desk drop
notifying employees of the verdict and possible ramifications of the decision. Again, final
approval of the desk drop and whether it is to be executed will rest with the appropriate
PM executives.

potential impact of the verdict on the company. Once the verdict is known, new sound
